items.title: Greg Abel Personally Bought $68 Million of Berkshire Stock in 2022, Years Before Becoming CEO. Here's Why That Early Bet on Himself Still Matters for Berkshire Shareholders Today.
items.summary: Greg Abel has skin in the game, committing early to eating his own cooking.

items.title: Polymarket Wagers on Bank Failures Trigger FDIC Concerns
items.summary: Polymarket bets on the likelihood that some of the biggest names in banking, including Wells Fargo & Co., JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Bank of America Corp., will fail are drawing scrutiny from officials in Washington, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: DB's 2028 Targets Gain Traction: What's Driving Growth Momentum?
items.summary: Deutsche Bank's Wealth Management and Corporate Bank gains, resilient NII, and cost savings strengthen its path toward 2028 financial targets.

items.title: Wells Fargo Says the AI Spending Math Breaks in 2028 and Just Cut Its S&P 500 Target to 7,700
items.summary: Wells Fargo's chief equity strategist sees a spending cliff forming inside the AI buildout, and the arithmetic he uses to locate it points to a very specific year when the math stops working for hyperscaler earnings.

items.title: Wells Fargo Names COO Powell as Next Chief Risk Officer
items.summary: Wells Fargo  Bank is appointing Chief Operating Officer  Scott Powell  as its next chief risk officer.  Powell will succeed  Derek Flowers,  who is retiring from the bank in January, it said Wednesday.  The company said Powell’s successor as operating chief will be appointed “in the near future.”

items.title: 32-Story Downtown Boston Office Tower Heading To Foreclosure Auction
items.summary: Wells Fargo foreclosed on 100 Summer St., a 32-story tower owned by Rockpoint Group. The auction is scheduled Oct. 20 with Sullivan & Sullivan.

items.title: How Meta's Muse, Vanguard AI Threat Triggered Schwab Sell Signal
items.summary: Charles Schwab stock recovered only modestly on Wednesday morning, a day after leading a wide swath of brokerage, bank and other financial stocks lower as AI-fueled competition heats up.  Rapid adoption of Meta Platforms' Muse personal AI agent and a growing threat from Altruist, an AI platform for financial advisors that was recently acquired by Vanguard, have highlighted two very different type of risks to Schwab's business.

items.title: How Does Meta's Muse AI Raise Risks for Banks & Other Finance Firms?
items.summary: Meta's Muse AI raises risks for finance firms by making it easier for customers to compare rates, fees and products, and move deposits or assets.
